vibe_rationale: Label-run riverside camping festival with a playful, community-heavy culture; a single scene and a little more commercial than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Summer camping crowd for house and bass (age not published), with hydration, sun care and recovery fitting the setting. Large community of about 81,000 Instagram followers. Twenty-six listed sponsors and a contact route, and partner deals may run through both the Dirtybird and Northern Nights teams.
